prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: canonical production character artwork for a real-time layered 2D landing-page companion.
Reference image: the attached Sylf design sheet is the authoritative visual design, not a source to crop or display. Newly redraw its exact character faithfully from scratch.
Primary request: ONE full-body ORIGINAL-palette Sylf, FRONT VIEW, neutral floating pose, matching the character labeled FRONT in the upper-middle turnaround and ORIGINAL in the upper-right color variants. This is a near-exact visual mimic, not a reinterpretation. No book, no tablet, no waving pose, no extra symbols. Use the large painted illustration on the left to resolve the soft polished illustration finish and fine shading.
Match carefully: oversized softly rounded bell/triangular hood with gently asymmetric folded ivory fabric and a softly drooping outer corner, large recessed dark navy face opening with curved lower edge, two small upright luminous white oval eyes with a restrained lilac glow; tiny dark floating torso; two short tapered rounded dark lower-body shapes; two warm cream leaf/petal-shaped front cloak panels with delicate peach-gold edging and soft blue-lilac underside; small faceted peach-gold diamond chest clasp with navy/periwinkle center; two flowing ribbon/scarf-like open loops behind the shoulders, warm ivory on their lit faces, pale periwinkle/lilac shaded undersides, graceful thin folds; thin gently tilted peach-gold elliptical halo floating just above the hood; one small faceted four-point gold star hovering above the halo. Preserve the reference front character's exact relative sizes and spacing, compact body and broad rounded hood, silhouette and charm.
Style: exactly the reference's soft dreamy polished painterly game illustration, delicate edges and luminous warm/cool fabric shading. Rounded simple shapes suitable for animation. NOT flat vector, NOT bold outlines, NOT hard polygon facets all over, NOT 3D plastic. Face has no human skin, nose, mouth or hair. Gender neutral.
Composition: one centered character, straight-on frontal neutral pose, complete star-to-feet silhouette with generous transparent margin, no crop, square canvas. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no ground shadow, no checkerboard, no labels or text, no logo. Original cream/navy/blue-lilac/peach-gold colors only. No inventions, no extra accessories, no alternate characters.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: final canonical production companion cutout.
Image 1 is the redraw to refine. Image 2 is the authoritative Sylf reference design sheet. Keep the character, painted finish, Original cream/indigo/lilac/pale peach palette and full-body neutral floating pose. 3. Bring the side ribbon loops inward: their total width should be only about 1.07 times the hood width, as in the FRONT reference, rather than widely outstretched. Preserve cream inner turns, lilac/periwinkle undersides and open negative-space loops.
4. Tuck the pointed blue rear cape tails up behind the cream cloak petals; their tips must end above the ends of the small navy lower-body lobes, like the reference. Preserve short compact navy body proportions.
5. Halo is a delicate thin pale peach-gold tilted elliptical ring, not a thick band. Keep the four-point faceted floating star.
Clean transparent alpha edges: no white granular/fringed outline, no background halo outside actual painted parts, no checkerboard. Retain soft dreamy polished illustration shading, tiny gold piping, and rounded shape language. No invented details, text, backgrounds, extra characters, props, facial features, or palette changes. Entire star-to-feet character centered with transparent margins.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Production animation-layer preparation of the supplied canonical character image. Preserve the image's composition, character scale, hood silhouette, body, ribbons, cloak, gold clasp, star and painted shading. Do not redraw or redesign those parts.
Make ONLY these precise changes:
A. Enlarge the dark indigo FACE OPENING within the hood. It is currently too small. Move its top apex substantially upward so the dark face begins about 20% of the hood's height below the hood crown, instead of the current 35%. Widen the opening by about 20%, preserving a softly rounded triangular shape and bowed bottom edge. The character should have a narrow cream hood brow surrounding a large recessed indigo face, like the reference FRONT view. Keep the outer hood exactly the same size and shape.
B. Remove BOTH eyes and their glow, filling those areas smoothly with the same dark indigo face shading. This is intentionally an EYE-FREE master for a real-time animation rig; movable eyes will be drawn as an independent layer in the website. Do not add any facial features or marks.
C. Make the halo ring's painted band one third its current thickness, a delicate pale peach-gold orbit line. Keep its current ellipse size, tilt and position.
D. Remove white speckled edge contamination around the outside of the art and inside the ring/loop openings. Clean smooth antialiasing and genuinely transparent alpha are required. No white fringe, fuzzy matte, or checkerboard.
Keep the full-body neutral front pose and original cream, pale blue-lilac, deep indigo and champagne-gold colors unchanged. No backdrop, floor shadow, text, new objects, or extra characters. Square transparent image, same framing.
